title: Smoky Italian Menemen
description: A smoky twist on the classic Turkish menemen, incorporating Italian flavors with prosciutto and jagged cheese.

ingredients.name: 2 tablespoons
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality, smoky olive oil

ingredients.name: 2 cloves
ingredients.notes: Mince fresh garlic for the best flavor
Use room temperature eggs for easier cooking

ingredients.name: 4 slices
ingredients.notes: Italian prosciutto is a great addition

instructions: 1. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
2. Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
3. Add the jagged cheese and cook for 2-3 minutes, until it starts to melt.
4. Crack in the eggs and scramble them with the cheese and garlic.
5. Add the diced prosciutto and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
6. Sprinkle with smoked paprika and season with salt and pepper to taste.
7. Serve immediately, garnished with additional jagged cheese if desired.
